patch_description: The current baseline uses only globally normalized direct demand and no interactions, so it misses useful relay structure. This version keeps direct demand dominant, adds a small concave adjustment to avoid concentrating all reward on the largest demands, and allocates a modest two-hop bonus across relays, mildly favoring nodes with lower traffic activity. Small reciprocal-link bonuses provide additional topology structure without overwhelming direct demand. The degree penalty is increased from 1.0 to 2.5 to make degree-feasible assignments more influential before repair. The interaction count remains well below the 4·n³ limit.
